evidence: The issue concerns the crash reporter client, which is covered by Toolkit::Crash Reporting under the OS Integration team.
Computed panel and OutputParser are part of the DevTools Inspector.
The report concerns split views inside collapsed tab groups being hidden after session restore or group dragging, matching Frontend's Tab Groups/Split View and Session Restore ownership.
The bug concerns .urlbar-input-box in the URL bar, which is part of Firefox::Address Bar under the Search Next Generation team.
The report describes a use-after-free in dom/indexedDB/ActorsParent.cpp and PBackgroundIDBRequest, which are IndexedDB/DOM LWS components.
The report is about SearchService not updating WebExtension-installed search engine names/URLs during live language switching, which is owned by Toolkit search.
The bug concerns the about:preferences Applications section UI, matching the Firefox::Settings UI component in the Frontend team.
The use-after-free is in mozilla::image::nsAVIFDecoder (ImageLib's AVIF decoder, Core::Graphics), which the GFX team owns.
The stack and affected files are in browser/components/urlbar/UrlbarParentController.sys.mjs and browser/actors/UrlbarParent.sys.mjs, which belong to the URL bar/search UI team.

The bug concerns focus management for the Site Information/Trust panel opened from the View site information button (#trust-icon-container), which belongs to Firefox::Site Identity under Privacy Engineering.
The bug is about the Server Not Found error page's Learn more link, which is handled by the about:neterror component.
The regression is in the DAMP browser-toolbox.inspector-ready test, a DevTools performance suite pointing at the Inspector/toolbox code.
The failing test path browser/components/customizableui/test indicates CustomizableUI/toolbar customization, matching prior Frontend routing for CustomizableUI failures.
SearchWidgetTracker and search-container widget removal are search UI concerns under Firefox::Search.
The bug concerns SERPCategorization.sys.mjs, which is part of search telemetry and owned by the Search Next Generation team.
The report concerns a use-after-munmap race in dom/canvas/DrawTargetWebgl.cpp and SharedContextWebgl::UploadSurface, which is GFX canvas/WebGL code.
The bug is about a theme color token (toolbar_field) for tab notes in the default light theme, which belongs to Firefox::Theme under Search Next Generation.
Failures are in /svg/animations/ animateMotion path tests, matching Core::SVG (layout/rendering of SVG content).
Crash stack is entirely in js/src/wasm, matching the JavaScript engine's WebAssembly component.
The crash involves the style system rule cache in servo/components/style/rule_cache.rs and @starting-style computed-style cascade, which falls under the Layout team.
The null dereference is in accessible/xul/XULFormControlAccessible.cpp during an accessibility state query.
Crash is in mozilla::AndroidSystemFontIterator and gfxAndroidPlatform's font API blocklist, which is platform font/graphics code owned by GFX.
Nova spotlights and the Spotlight template are Firefox Messaging System surfaces, owned by the Onboarding, Messaging, and Communication team.
Scroll performance tests (tp5o_scroll, tscrollx) typically belong to GFX.
Address capture/update doorhanger and Form Autofill prefs point to Credential Management.
Bug mentions incorrect precision in Firefox's built-in WebGL shaders within DrawTargetWebgl, a graphics subsystem issue.
The build error is in js/src/jit platform code (callWithABI signature change for InitBaselineFrameForOsr) on riscv64/mips64, matching the JavaScript Engine JIT porting team.
JXL decoding is handled by ImageLib in the Core::Graphics components under the GFX team.
Stack shows Services.fog.initializeFOG()/StartupTelemetry registering RunOnShutdown for AppShutdownConfirmed, a Glean/FOG (Telemetry) shutdown-phase issue.
The bug concerns nsHttpTransaction/HttpTransactionParent pending time in the socket process, which is Necko networking code.
The failing test is a WebRTC WPT for mDNS ICE candidate obfuscation, which is owned by Core::WebRTC in the Media team.
The report names media-specific IPC actors RemoteMediaDataEncoderChild and RemoteCDMChild and references CDMProxy/MediaDataEncoder lifetimes.
The leak is in widget/gtk/nsGtkKeyUtils.cpp, which maps to Core::Widget: Gtk under OS Integration.
Stack trace points to layout/painting/nsDisplayList.cpp and nsDisplayText, which is owned by Layout.
The report references Figma spec design inconsistencies, matching the Frontend team's UI/visual design bugs.
Crash assertion is in gfx/wr/webrender/src/prepare.rs, i.e. the WebRender component under the GFX team.
The VPN Promo message frequency is controlled by the Messaging System/CFR experiments.
The report links invisible PDF text selection to backdrop-filter being blocklisted or disabled, a graphics feature owned by GFX.
WPT CSS test failure about computed value of animation-duration points to CSS property implementation in Core::CSS Parsing and Computation (Layout), consistent with prior CSS WPT routing to Layout.
Stack trace shows js/src/wasm and js::jit CodeGenerator WebAssembly compiler code, matching prior WebAssembly bugs routed to the JavaScript team.
Heap-use-after-free in dom/file/MutableBlobStorage.cpp involving TemporaryIPCBlobChild points to Core::DOM: File ownership.
The bug concerns a messaging experiment spotlight’s telemetry pings showing the wrong message ID.
Identical to a known GFX bug about border-radius, filter, and overflow clipping.
Stack trace shows heap-use-after-free inside gfx/harfbuzz and gfxFont::GetBaseline, indicating the graphics/font team owns the fix.
The bug concerns the new searchbar and TabToSearch/ContextualSearch behavior, which falls under Firefox::Search in the Search Next Generation team.

The report is about clearing site data while in Private Browsing mode (and hiding the Clear Data UI), matching the Privacy Engineering team's Firefox::Private Browsing / Toolkit::Data Sanitization components, just like the near-identical already-routed bug.
The bug involves DoH (DNS over HTTPS) and a network connection error (PR_END_OF_FILE_ERROR), which are handled by the Networking component.
Prior querySelector optimization bugs are routed to Layout, and selector matching is a Layout-team component.
The bug is in RTCDTMFSender.cpp under dom/media/webrtc/jsapi, matching the Media team's WebRTC/DTMF component.
Crash stack is in dom/media/webspeech/recognition/SpeechRecognitionParent, and Core::Web Speech is owned by Media.
The failing test is dom/base/test/test_wasm_offthread_compile.html, which exercises WebAssembly off-main-thread compilation owned by Core::JavaScript: WebAssembly.
